explication: WidevineProxy2 is a browser extension that intercepts EME challenge and license traffic, transforms Widevine messages to retrieve content keys, and presents keys and DRM status in a GUI. The main flow starts at a video page, passes through EME interception and the extension’s isolated bridge, then uses either a local Widevine implementation or a remote CDM; captured results are stored and shown in the popup or history. The README documents manifest/status monitoring and device setup. Some UI, background, and manifest-watching connections are documented or inferred from module roles rather than fully visible in the excerpts.
